item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows a rectangle covered by $1$ cm by $1$ cm unit squares. Alok counts $6$ squares along the length and $2$ along the width.

One or more options may be correct. Which two claims are correct?

options.A: The area is $12$ square centimetres, because $6\times 2$ unit squares fill the rectangle.
options.B: The area is $8$ cm, by adding $6$ and $2$ and dropping square units.
options.C: The area equals length multiplied by width, reported in square units.
options.D: The area is $6$ square centimetres, because $6$ is the longer side printed on the diagram.
